title: Lab - Files, directories, hard and soft links
description: Build and inspect a small directory tree with both kinds of link.
scenario: Build and inspect a small directory tree with both kinds of link. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Tree
tasks.instructions: Create /opt/lab/{bin,etc,logs} in one command and a file in each.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Hard link
tasks.instructions: Hard-link app.conf to /opt/lab/app.conf.bak and prove they share an inode.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Soft link
tasks.instructions: Create a relative soft link /opt/lab/current -> logs/app.log, then move the target and observe.
